flower.label: Flower
flower.intro: Flower is the dried and cured bud of the cannabis plant, sold loose by weight. It is ground and then smoked in a pipe or rolled paper, or heated in a dry herb vaporizer.
flower.alt: A surreal still life of cannabis flower buds floating above a white plinth on a pale sky ground

buzzy.quote: Flower is loose cannabis intended to be smoked or vaporized with appropriate equipment.
Let’s get straight to the point: an eighth of cannabis is 3.5 grams.

pre-rolls.label: Pre-Rolls
pre-rolls.intro: A pre-roll is ground cannabis flower already rolled in paper and ready to light. It is smoked like a joint, with no grinding or rolling needed.
pre-rolls.alt: A surreal still life of a single cone shaped pre-roll floating above a white plinth on a pale sky ground

buzzy.quote: Pre-rolls are ready-made joints and may be infused or non-infused.

vapes.label: Vapes
vapes.intro: A vape heats cannabis oil or extract into an inhalable vapor without burning it. Most use a cartridge or pod that attaches to a rechargeable battery.
vapes.alt: A surreal still life of a plain vape pen and cartridge floating above a white plinth on a pale sky ground

buzzy.quote: Our menu rotates daily with fresh, locally-sourced flower, artisanal edibles, and premium vapes.

edibles.label: Edibles
edibles.intro: Edibles are foods, confections and drinks made with cannabis, such as gummies, chocolates and beverages. They are eaten or sipped rather than inhaled, and come portioned into servings.
edibles.alt: A surreal still life of round gummies and a square of chocolate floating above a white plinth on a pale sky ground

buzzy.quote: Edibles are foods or confections containing cannabis and can take longer to be felt than inhaled products.
For edibles and beverages, serving information is one of the most useful parts of the package.

concentrates.label: Concentrates
concentrates.intro: Concentrates are extracts that collect the resin of the cannabis plant in forms such as rosin, hash, wax and live resin. They are usually vaporized in a dab rig or a dedicated device.
concentrates.alt: A surreal still life of a small glass jar of golden rosin floating above a white plinth on a pale sky ground

buzzy.quote: Explore our curated catalog of premium craft cannabis, artisanal concentrates, and design-forward accessories.

tinctures.label: Tinctures
tinctures.intro: A tincture is a liquid cannabis extract in a small bottle with a dropper. It is measured out by the dropper and taken under the tongue or mixed into food and drinks.
tinctures.alt: A surreal still life of an amber dropper bottle floating above a white plinth on a pale sky ground

topicals.label: Topicals
topicals.intro: Topicals are cannabis infused balms, lotions and creams. They are applied to the skin rather than inhaled or eaten.
topicals.alt: A surreal still life of an open tin of balm floating above a white plinth on a pale sky ground

accessories.label: Accessories
accessories.intro: Accessories are the tools used with cannabis, such as grinders, rolling papers, pipes, batteries and vaporizers. They are used to prepare, consume or store cannabis.
accessories.alt: A surreal still life of a grinder and rolling papers floating above a white plinth on a pale sky ground

buzzy.quote: Explore our curated catalog of premium craft cannabis, artisanal concentrates, and design-forward accessories.
